kings2.10.p1.b1.text: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. So Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria to the officials of Jezreel, to the elders, and to the guardians of the sons of Ahab, …

kings2.10.p1.b2.text: … select the best and most worthy son of your master, set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.

kings2.10.p1.b3.text: If two kings could not stand against him, how can we?

kings2.10.p1.b4.text: We are your servants, and we will do whatever you say. We will not make anyone king. Do whatever is good in your sight.

kings2.10.p2.b1.text: If you are on my side, and if you will obey me, then bring the heads of your master’s sons to me at Jezreel by this time tomorrow.

kings2.10.p2.b2.text: And when the letter arrived, they took the sons of the king and slaughtered all seventy of them. They put their heads in baskets and sent them to Jehu at Jezreel.

kings2.10.p2.b3.text: You are innocent. … But who killed all these? Know, then, that not a word the LORD has spoken against the house of Ahab will fail, …

kings2.10.p2.b4.text: So Jehu killed everyone in Jezreel who remained of the house of Ahab, as well as all his great men and close friends and priests, leaving him without a single survivor.

kings2.10.p3.b2.text: We are relatives of Ahaziah, … and we have come down to greet the sons of the king and of the queen mother.

kings2.10.p3.b4.text: Is your heart as true to mine as my heart is to yours? … Come with me and see my zeal for the LORD!

kings2.10.p4.b1.text: When Jehu came to Samaria, he struck down everyone belonging to Ahab who remained there, until he had destroyed them, according to the word that the LORD had spoken to Elijah.

kings2.10.p4.b2.text: Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him a lot. … Whoever is missing will not live.

kings2.10.p4.b3.text: But Jehu was acting deceptively in order to destroy the servants of Baal.

kings2.10.p4.b4.text: Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal.

kings2.10.p5.b1.text: all the servants of Baal came; there was not a man who failed to show. They entered the temple of Baal, and it was filled from end to end.

kings2.10.p5.b2.text: Bring out garments for all the servants of Baal.

kings2.10.p5.b3.text: Look around to see that there are no servants of the LORD here among you—only servants of Baal.

kings2.10.p5.b4.text: If anyone allows one of the men I am delivering into your hands to escape, he will forfeit his life for theirs.

kings2.10.p6.b1.text: Go in and kill them. Do not let anyone out.

kings2.10.p6.b2.text: They brought out the sacred pillar of the temple of Baal and burned it.

kings2.10.p6.b3.text: They also demolished the sacred pillar of Baal. Then they tore down the temple of Baal and made it into a latrine, which it is to this day.

kings2.10.p6.b4.text: Thus Jehu eradicated Baal from Israel,
